items.title: Partial symplectic homogenization by slow-variable constraint elimination and controlled generating-function composition
items.difficulty_reason: Relative to the already counted full homogenization construction, partial homogenization adds a two-scale symplectic form and generating-function composition with slow-variable constraints. The author eliminates the slow auxiliary variables by the Hadamard map argument, controls the block-tridiagonal inverse and C1 perturbation, and compares the ell-fold composition by C ell/k while spreading defects with 2m+1 shifted sets for the reciprocal-ell error. This nonduplicated constrained composition/error construction supports one H2; the shared cycle and inverse mechanisms are counted only in A. The parameter extension at2318 remains an author assertion at its written granularity.
